basic_info.description: Welcome to Pacific Heights, where grand historic mansions are interspersed with some of the finest single-family homes in The City. Minutes from outdoor recreation and tennis courts at lush Lafayette Park, the residence at 1994 Jackson Street offers the absolute finest in modern family living. The home has gone through a complete renovation while maintaining the classic period authentic details often found in grand homes of this caliber. The home has been completely re-scripted with an aesthetic, catering to the 21st-century family while incorporating the best finishes of yesterday and today. Expansive panoramic vistas that extend across the San Francisco Bay fill the main living areas with natural sunlight, accentuating the elegant wide-plank walnut floors. An elevator accesses 3 of the 4 levels which includes 4 bedrooms, 6 full bathrooms, 1 powder room, spacious formal rooms, a gourmet kitchen, recreation room, and entertainment venue opening to a garden. Minutes from shopping, quaint cafes, and fine restaurants, this updated residence truly epitomizes a relaxed city lifestyle.
